info.description: Orxest is a project-centric orchestration platform for AI-assisted software development. Agents perform work; Orxest decides how work moves through the system. Projects own issues, tasks and a workflow; the workflow selects role-based agents for each step, the scheduler runs them in isolated Git worktrees, and every attempt is preserved as an execution.
